source_findings.title: actual GO delivery finishes beyond spawn-age/runtime bound
source_findings.implementation: completion_check('GO') now FIRST records actual post-write/extra-line/close mono, spawn age, min(60,wall/2) bound and remaining main runtime. Age beyond the bound latches GO_COMPLETION_AGE_EXCEEDED; no remaining runtime latches GO_COMPLETION_MAIN_RUNTIME_EXPIRED plus wall enforcement. Both use the existing owned stop. Lateness raises after recording the delivered token, never invents an undelivered GO. Pre-write age/registration/reaped-PID/cancel/expiry/resource guards remain.
source_findings.required_empirical_cases: Both wall10/bound5 and wall200/bound60, actual completion bound-0.01/equal/bound+0.01, including a delayed native write after a valid pre-write gate. None exercised.

source_findings.title: civil-clock rollback renews stability window
source_findings.implementation: The first actual conservative /bin/date observation fixes stability_expiry_mono = pre-reading mono + max_age - (date_floor-stability_epoch+1s). Every later actual observation can ONLY min/tighten this expiry, never extend it. Helper reports retain before/candidate/effective cutoffs. stability_age enforces the maximum of current actual-date bound and monotonic elapsed bound from the immutable/tightened expiry. Rollback cannot renew freshness. Mandatory actual date, frozen receipt and future/canonical checks stay.
source_findings.required_empirical_cases: Upper ages299.99/equal300/300.01; missing/malformed/naive/future; rollback/refresh through separately reviewed clock-state fixture WITHOUT host-clock mutation or fake actual /bin/date output. None exercised.

source_findings.title: aborted attempts or post-publication refusal lose observations
source_findings.implementation: Every completed identity read is retained immediately, with first/last identity, bounded fingerprint variants and observation bounds, BEFORE another PID/edge/deadline may abort. New unproved identities and unresolved reads are retained immediately rather than only at scan completion. Identity/resource attempts are pre-registered; finally records end/abort/error. Each fully bracketed resource measurement is retained before later I/O, partial totals updated and observed RSS/BUSY/headroom enforced immediately and again before propagating abort. Aborted census stays complete=false and is never a clearance witness. Byte/count/variant caps fail closed, retain an overflow witness and halt further scans, not silently truncate.
source_findings.refusal_evidence: Every refusal, including after frozen receipt publication, emits CURRENT compact known/unproved/identity/coverage/attempt/resource/helper evidence plus precise machine error_code. If an ACK was already printed, actualexit14 and a separate stderr POST_ACK_REFUSAL_EVIDENCE record carry current reconciliation rather than issuing a contradictory second ACK. Parent must capture stdout AND stderr and verify actual exit. Thus a transient U observed after publication remains emitted even if it exits before the parent census.
source_findings.bounded_cap_path: Conservative4MiB history accounting plus existing entry/variant caps bound stored evidence. Once capped, new scans stop. Once-only raw stop identity witnesses remain in main/helper signal records so the owned TERM can still be verified. Helper cap-path still performs bounded WNOHANG reap/drain/close, but explicitly NEVER claims unavailable group/coverage settlement. Unsettled ownership retains parent hold.
source_findings.required_empirical_cases: Transient identity/BUSY/RSS incomplete-then-clean; aborted identity/resource scans; new U forcing ACK refusal; post-publication stop-helper activity; history caps at limit-1/equal/limit+1 using bounded fixtures. None exercised.
